description: Fetches labels for a specified Trello board, aiding in its organization or label management; this action does not detail per-card label usage.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving labels from a specific Trello board.

fields.description: Determines which label fields to return. Use 'all' for all available fields, or a comma-separated list of specific fields from: color, idBoard, name, uses. Defaults to 'all'.
fields.title: Fields

idBoard.description: The unique 24-character hexadecimal identifier of the Trello board.
idBoard.title: Id Board

limit.description: The maximum number of labels to be returned. Must be an integer between 0 and 1000, inclusive. Defaults to 50.
limit.title: Limit

inputSchema.title: GetBoardsLabelsByIdBoardRequest

name: get_boards_labels_by_id_board

GetBoardsLabelsByIdBoardResponse.description: Response schema containing the list of labels for the specified Trello board.

labels.description: Array of label objects on the board.
labels.title: Labels

GetBoardsLabelsByIdBoardResponse.title: GetBoardsLabelsByIdBoardResponse

Label.description: Represents a label on a Trello board.

color.description: The color of the label. Null means no color and the label will not be shown on the front of Cards. Valid values: yellow, purple, blue, red, green, orange, black, sky, pink, lime, or null.
color.title: Color

idBoard.description: The ID of the board the label is on.
idBoard.title: Id Board

name.description: The name displayed for the label. Nullable, with a maximum length of 16384 characters.
name.title: Name

Label.title: Label
